newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morocco railway company wins 150 mln Fr credit-BNP.
newsitem.headline: Morocco railway company wins 150 mln Fr credit-BNP.

text.p: A bank syndicate has signed a 150 million franc credit line for Morocco's railway operator, Office National des Chemins de Fer Marocains (ONCF), lead bank Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) said on Thursday.
Other banks in the group include Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce Exterieur and Banque Commerciale du Maroc.
The loan tops up other facilities from the World Bank, the African Development Bank and the European investment Bank for a 5.2 billion dirham investment programme by the rail company.
